title: Act: Add sound and settings flags and toggles to uiStore.ts
description: Extend the UiState interface and the store created by ACT1 with soundEnabled, settingsOpen, toggleSound and toggleSettings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the store, when read, then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
Given the toggles, when called, then only their own flag flips

steps.action: Add soundEnabled: boolean and settingsOpen: boolean, toggleSound: () => void and toggleSettings: () => void to the UiState interface. Add the initial values soundEnabled: true and settingsOpen: false, and the two toggle actions to the create callback.
steps.code:
soundEnabled: true,
settingsOpen: false,
toggleSound: () => set((s) => ({ soundEnabled: !s.soundEnabled })),
toggleSettings: () => set((s) => ({ settingsOpen: !s.settingsOpen })),
steps.expected: The store exposes soundEnabled true and settingsOpen false, and each toggle flips only its own flag
